note: Alias registry for the spec-conformance matrix. `aliases` are the strings a test title may use for this spec; the joiner resolves them to `id`, so a citation grammar can drift without touching a single requirement row. `sealed: true` means the row list is complete for every section the suite cites, so a citation that resolves to no row is a build failure; `sealed: false` means rows are still being written and an unmatched citation is only reported. See ./README.md.

specs.name: RFC 9700 — Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 Security
The OAuth 2.1 Authorization Framework (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-17)
specs.scopeNote: The authorization-code replay rows of §4.1.3 and §7.5.3 only (#627). Registered under its draft revision because section numbers move between drafts: a test cites `OAuth 2.1 draft-17 §…`, and the bare `OAuth` token stays a foreign anchor, so the suite's older `OAuth 2.1 §…` citations neither prove nor orphan against these rows. Re-pinning to a later draft is a deliberate pass over these rows and the citing titles (docs/spec-pin-log.md).
